'''Lazlo Ardine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the conflict, Ardine was selected to command [[Strike Force Cularin]], a strikeforce that was made up of units from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Cularin Militia]] and [[Thaereian military]]. He led them on a [[Mission to the Ando system|mission]] to the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]], where they captured a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] and attacked a Separatist base on a [[Unidentified Ando system planetoid|planetoid]] in the system. During the attack, he overheard his second-in-command, Colonel [[Rast'tul]], confess to an attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Heroes of Cularin]], so Ardine ordered some [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] arrest him.

He was later aboard the [[Relentless (cruiser)|''Relentless'']] during the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]].

==Personality and traits==
Ardine was a career [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and was committed to fighting and doing what he thought to be right. Although he respected the fighting abilities of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], he felt that they shouldn't have been given command of the Grand Army. Prior to the mission to the Ando system, he disliked the Cularin Militia's war against the Thaereians, as he believed that the Thaereian military was justified in being in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. However, the mission changed his perspective on this and afterward, he was more sympathetic to the Militia.
